## Animation

### Animator

Plays a skeleton's animations: an animation controller's states, or one clip

Display name: Animator · Added by people and tools: yes · Removable: yes

| Property | Display name | Type | Default | Range | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Skeleton` | Skeleton | `Asset` | `0000000000000000` | Asset type: `Skeleton`. | The joints the animations move (a model's Skeleton). |
| `Controller` | Controller | `Asset` | `0000000000000000` | Asset type: `AnimationController`. | States, transitions and parameters; without one the animator plays Clip. |
| `Clip` | Clip | `Asset` | `0000000000000000` | Asset type: `AnimationClip`. | The clip played without a controller. Inactive (it has no effect) when: The controller's states choose the clips (Controller is set). |
| `Speed` | Speed | `Float` | `1` | `-100.0` to `100.0`. | Playback rate; negative plays backwards. |
| `Loop` | Loop | `Bool` | `true` |   | Whether the clip (without a controller) repeats. |
| `PlayOnStart` | Play On Start | `Bool` | `true` |   | Starts playing when the scene starts. |
| `ApplyRootMotion` | Apply Root Motion | `Bool` | `false` |   | Moves the entity by the root joint's horizontal motion and turn. |
| `CullingMode` | Culling Mode | `Enum` | `AlwaysAnimate` | One of: `AlwaysAnimate`, `WhenVisible`. | When Visible poses the skeleton only while a renderer draws a mesh it skins or its shadow; one that skins no mesh but moves attached parts poses always. |

## Lighting

### DirectionalLight

Sun-like light shining along the entity's forward (-Z) direction; its intensity is illuminance in lux

Display name: Directional Light · Added by people and tools: yes · Removable: yes

| Property | Display name | Type | Default | Range | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Color` | Color | `Color3` | `[1, 1, 1]` |   | Linear color of the light, times Intensity: (1, 1, 1) for the midday sun; the physical atmosphere dims and reddens it toward the horizon itself, so tint it only for a look. Inspector section: Light. |
| `Intensity` | Intensity | `Float` | `3` | `0.0` to `1000000.0`. | Illuminance in lux on a surface facing the light, times Color: direct sun about 100,000, an overcast day 1,000 to 10,000, a full moon 0.25. Inspector section: Light. |
| `ShadowSoftness` | Angular Diameter | `Float` | `0.53` | `0.0` to `10.0`. | Angular diameter of the light's disk in degrees (the sun: about 0.53; an overcast sky's soft sun up to 10): its shadows' penumbra widens with the distance from the caster, and its highlight on smooth surfaces takes the disk's size. 0: the hardest shadow the filter allows and a point-like highlight. Inspector section: Light. |
| `CastShadows` | Cast Shadows | `Bool` | `true` |   | Whether the light casts shadows: cascaded shadow maps out to Shadow Distance, their resolution and number set by Project Settings &gt; Graphics Quality. Inspector section: Shadows. |
| `ShadowDistance` | Shadow Distance | `Float` | `80` | `1.0` to `10000.0`. | Meters from the camera the shadows reach; the last cascade fades out before it. Shorter spends the same shadow-map texels on less ground: sharper near shadows. Inactive (it has no effect) when: Cast Shadows is off. Inspector section: Shadows. |
| `ShadowBias` | Shadow Bias | `Float` | `1` | `0.0` to `10.0`. | Depth offset toward the light in shadow-map texels: raise it against shadow acne (stripes on lit surfaces), lower it when shadows detach from their casters. Inactive (it has no effect) when: Cast Shadows is off. Inspector section: Shadows. |
| `ShadowNormalBias` | Shadow Normal Bias | `Float` | `1.5` | `0.0` to `10.0`. | Offset of the lookup along the surface normal in shadow-map texels: raise it against acne on surfaces at grazing angles to the light. Inactive (it has no effect) when: Cast Shadows is off. Inspector section: Shadows. |
| `CascadeBlend` | Cascade Blend | `Float` | `0.1` | `0.0` to `0.5`. | Fraction of each shadow cascade's depth range over which it blends into the next one, hiding the seams between them; the last one fades out by the Shadow Distance. 0 switches at once. Inactive (it has no effect) when: Cast Shadows is off. Inspector section: Shadows. |
| `ContactShadowLength` | Contact Shadow Length | `Float` | `0.3` | `0.0` to `2.0`. | Meters toward the light over which contact shadows ground objects smaller than the shadow cascades' texels, when Graphics Quality's Contact Shadows has steps (Custom; no preset draws them); 0 off. Inactive (it has no effect) when: Cast Shadows is off. Inspector section: Shadows. |
| `CascadeDistribution` | Cascade Distribution | `Float` | `0.9` | `0.0` to `1.0`. | How the cascades share the distance from 1.5 m to the Shadow Distance: 0 evenly, 1 each cascade the same ratio farther than the previous. Higher puts more detail near the camera. Inactive (it has no effect) when: Cast Shadows is off. Inspector section: Shadows. |

### LightSurface

Marks this emissive mesh as the face of an area light (Make Area Light adds it): screen-space reflections, reflection probe captures and area lights' shadows leave its emission out, so the panel is not counted twice. The mesh still draws, casts the sun's and other lights' shadows and is picked as before

Display name: Light Surface · Added by people and tools: yes · Removable: yes

No properties.

### PointLight

Light shining in every direction from the entity's position, with shadows in six directions when it casts them; its intensity is luminous intensity in candela

Display name: Point Light · Added by people and tools: yes · Removable: yes

| Property | Display name | Type | Default | Range | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Color` | Color | `Color3` | `[1, 1, 1]` |   |   |
| `Intensity` | Intensity | `Float` | `10` | `0.0` to `1000000.0`. | Luminous intensity in candela, times Color, falling off with the square of the distance: a bulb of P lumens has P / 12.57 cd (800 lm, about 64 cd), a candle about 1. |
| `Range` | Range | `Float` | `10` | `0.009999999776482582` to `1000000.0`. | Light fades to zero at this distance. |
| `SourceRadius` | Source Radius | `Float` | `0` | `0.0` to `2.0`. | Radius in meters of the light's bulb or flame: smooth and wet surfaces show its highlight at that size, the same light spread wider (a lantern about 0.05, a fire about 0.25). Its diffuse light and shadows do not change. 0: a point. |
| `CastShadows` | Cast Shadows | `Bool` | `false` |   | Casts shadows: the renderer gives the most relevant shadowed lights in view (16) tiles of its shadow atlas, six for a point light, one for a spot light; each costs drawing its casters again when they move. |
| `ShadowBias` | Shadow Bias | `Float` | `1` | `0.0` to `10.0`. | Depth offset toward the light, in texels of the light's shadow tiles: raise it if lit surfaces show stripes of shadow (acne). Inactive (it has no effect) when: Cast Shadows is off. |
| `ShadowNormalBias` | Shadow Normal Bias | `Float` | `1.5` | `0.0` to `10.0`. | Offset along the surface normal, in texels of the light's shadow tiles: raise it against acne on surfaces lit at grazing angles; too much detaches shadows from their casters. Inactive (it has no effect) when: Cast Shadows is off. |
| `ShadowFilterRadius` | Shadow Filter Radius | `Float` | `1.5` | `0.0` to `8.0`. | Radius of the shadow's soft edge, in texels of the light's shadow tiles (0 to 8). Inactive (it has no effect) when: Cast Shadows is off. |

### RectLight

Rectangle light shining along the entity's forward (-Z) direction from its X-Y plane, lighting every pixel with its face's diffuse light and highlight; its intensity is the luminance of its face in nits, or its power in lumens

Display name: Rect Light · Added by people and tools: yes · Removable: yes

| Property | Display name | Type | Default | Range | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Color` | Color | `Color3` | `[1, 1, 1]` |   | Linear color of the light, times Intensity. |
| `Intensity` | Intensity | `Float` | `25` | `0.0` to `1000000.0`. | Luminance of the face in nits (cd/m²), times Color, with Units Nits (an LED ceiling panel about 3,000, a lit sign 1,000, a softbox 10,000); its power in lumens with Units Lumens (an LED panel of 60 x 60 cm about 3,600 lm). |
| `Units` | Units | `Enum` | `Nits` | One of: `Nits`, `Lumens`. | Nits: Intensity is the face's luminance, as an emissive material's (resizing keeps its brightness); Lumens: the power the light emits, spread over its face (resizing keeps its power; a two-sided light shares it between its faces). |
| `Width` | Width | `Float` | `1` | `0.0010000000474974513` to `100.0`. | Meters along the entity's X axis, times its scale. |
| `Height` | Height | `Float` | `0.5` | `0.0010000000474974513` to `100.0`. | Meters along the entity's Y axis, times its scale. |
| `TwoSided` | Two Sided | `Bool` | `false` |   | Emits from both faces. Nits: each face has the Intensity's luminance (twice the power); Lumens: the faces share the power (each half as bright). |
| `Range` | Range | `Float` | `10` | `0.009999999776482582` to `1000000.0`. | Light fades to zero at this distance from the rectangle. |
| `CastShadows` | Cast Shadows | `Bool` | `false` |   | Soft shadows, filtered with the light's own size: sharp where an object meets the floor, wider further away. Takes six views of the local shadow atlas (five for a one-sided ceiling panel) from Max Shadowed Local Lights' budget. |
| `ShadowBias` | Shadow Bias | `Float` | `1` | `0.0` to `10.0`. | Depth offset toward the light, in texels of the light's shadow tiles: raise it if lit surfaces show stripes of shadow (acne). Inactive (it has no effect) when: Cast Shadows is off. |
| `ShadowNormalBias` | Shadow Normal Bias | `Float` | `1.5` | `0.0` to `10.0`. | Offset along the surface normal, in texels of the light's shadow tiles: raise it against acne on surfaces lit at grazing angles; too much detaches shadows from their casters. Inactive (it has no effect) when: Cast Shadows is off. |

### SkyLight

Image-based lighting and sky background from an HDR environment map, a procedural sky or a physical atmosphere lit by the directional light; its radiance is luminance in nits (cd/m²) times its intensity (the atmosphere's: per lux of the light's illuminance)

Display name: Sky Light · Added by people and tools: yes · Removable: yes

| Property | Display name | Type | Default | Range | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Source` | Source | `Enum` | `EnvironmentMap` | One of: `EnvironmentMap`, `Procedural`, `Atmosphere`. | EnvironmentMap: an HDR texture; Procedural: a sky computed from the colors below and the directional light; Atmosphere: Earth's sky lit by the directional light, which it dims and reddens toward the horizon. |
| `EnvironmentMap` | Environment Map | `Asset` | `0000000000000000` | Asset type: `Texture`. | Equirectangular HDR texture. Inactive (it has no effect) when: Only an environment map uses it (Source is {}). |
| `Intensity` | Intensity | `Float` | `1` | `0.0` to `1000000.0`. | Multiplies the sky's luminance in nits (cd/m²): an environment map's values, the procedural colors, the ambient color, and the atmosphere's sky (nits per lux of the directional light). |
| `Rotation` | Rotation | `Float` | `0` | `-360.0` to `360.0`. | Degrees around +Y (environment maps only). Inactive (it has no effect) when: Only an environment map uses it (Source is {}). |
| `ShowBackground` | Show Background | `Bool` | `true` |   |   |
| `BackgroundBlur` | Background Blur | `Float` | `0` | `0.0` to `1.0`. | Inactive (it has no effect) when: The atmosphere's background is always sharp (Source is Atmosphere). |
| `AmbientColor` | Ambient Color | `Color3` | `[0.03, 0.03, 0.04]` |   | Ambient sky luminance in nits (linear, times Intensity) while there is no environment (no map set). Inactive (it has no effect) when: The procedural sky lights the scene: the ambient color applies only without an environment; The atmosphere lights the scene: the ambient color applies only without an environment; The environment map lights the scene: the ambient color applies only without one. |
| `ZenithColor` | Zenith Color | `Color3` | `[0.045, 0.08, 0.155]` |   | Procedural sky: luminance straight up in nits (linear, times Intensity). Inactive (it has no effect) when: Only the procedural sky uses it (Source is {}). |
| `HorizonColor` | Horizon Color | `Color3` | `[0.165, 0.185, 0.21]` |   | Procedural sky: luminance at the horizon in nits (linear, times Intensity). Inactive (it has no effect) when: Only the procedural sky uses it (Source is {}). |
| `GroundColor` | Ground Color | `Color3` | `[0.055, 0.05, 0.045]` |   | Procedural sky: luminance below the horizon in nits (linear, times Intensity). Inactive (it has no effect) when: Only the procedural sky uses it (Source is {}). |
| `SunSize` | Sun Size | `Float` | `0.53` | `0.0` to `20.0`. | Procedural sky and atmosphere: angular diameter of the sun's disk in degrees (0 hides it). Inactive (it has no effect) when: Only the procedural sky and the atmosphere draw a sun (Source is Environment Map). |
| `SunIntensity` | Sun Intensity | `Float` | `20` | `0.0` to `60000.0`. | Procedural sky: luminance of the sun's disk in nits, times the directional light's color (not its intensity) and this sky's Intensity. Inactive (it has no effect) when: Only the procedural sky uses it (Source is {}). |
| `AtmosphereDensity` | Atmosphere Density | `Float` | `1` | `0.0` to `10.0`. | Atmosphere: density of its air and aerosols (1: Earth's); thicker air reddens the sun sooner. Inactive (it has no effect) when: Only the atmosphere uses it (Source is {}). |
| `AtmosphereHaze` | Atmosphere Haze | `Float` | `1` | `0.0` to `10.0`. | Atmosphere: amount of aerosols (1: a clear day), the whitish haze and glow around the sun. Inactive (it has no effect) when: Only the atmosphere uses it (Source is {}). |
| `GroundAlbedo` | Ground Albedo | `Float` | `0.3` | `0.0` to `1.0`. | Atmosphere: diffuse reflectance of the planet's ground, which lights the sky from below. Inactive (it has no effect) when: Only the atmosphere uses it (Source is {}). |
| `AerialPerspective` | Aerial Perspective | `Bool` | `true` |   | Atmosphere: distant surfaces fade into the air's haze, as the sky does (aerial perspective). Inactive (it has no effect) when: Only the atmosphere uses it (Source is {}). |
| `AerialPerspectiveScale` | Aerial Perspective Scale | `Float` | `1` | `0.0` to `64.0`. | Atmosphere: distances multiplied by this for the haze: 1 is Earth's air, 4 makes a 1 km view look like 4 km. Inactive (it has no effect) when: Aerial Perspective is off; Only the atmosphere uses it (Source is {}). |

### HeightFog

Fog that thickens toward the ground, over the scene's surfaces and its sky (the first active one applies)

Display name: Height Fog · Added by people and tools: yes · Removable: yes

| Property | Display name | Type | Default | Range | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Density` | Density | `Float` | `0.02` | `0.0` to `1000000.0`. | Extinction per meter at the base height: 0.02 hides half of what lies 35 m away. |
| `HeightFalloff` | Height Falloff | `Float` | `0.2` | `9.999999747378752e-05` to `1000000.0`. | Per meter: the density falls by the factor e every 1 / falloff meters above the base height and rises below it. |
| `BaseHeight` | Base Height | `Float` | `0` | `-1000000.0` to `1000000.0`. | World height in meters where the density is Density. |
| `StartDistance` | Start Distance | `Float` | `0` | `0.0` to `1000000.0`. | Meters from the camera before which there is no fog. |
| `MaxOpacity` | Max Opacity | `Float` | `1` | `0.0` to `1.0`. | The most the fog hides of what lies behind it; the sky at the horizon gets this much. |
| `Color` | Color | `Color3` | `[0.7, 0.8, 0.9]` |   | Linear albedo: the fraction of its light the fog scatters toward the viewer. |
| `ColorFromSky` | Color From Sky | `Bool` | `true` |   | The sky lights the fog: the procedural sky's horizon color, an environment map's light from above, or the ambient color without either; off, Color is the fog's own radiance. The directional light lights it either way. |
| `SunScattering` | Sun Scattering | `Float` | `0.5` | `0.0` to `1.0`. | How strongly the fog scatters the directional light toward a viewer looking at it: 0 equally in every direction, 1 into a glow around the light. |

| `AmbientOcclusionIntensity` | Ambient Occlusion Intensity | `Float` | `1` | `0.0` to `4.0`. | How strongly the occlusion darkens ambient light: 1 as measured, 0 none, above 1 stronger. Inactive (it has no effect) when: Ambient Occlusion is off. Inspector section: Ambient occlusion. |
| `AmbientOcclusionMultiBounce` | Ambient Occlusion Multi Bounce | `Bool` | `true` |   | Occluded corners of bright surfaces keep the light their walls reflect into them: white plaster stays light in its creases, dark soil darkens fully. | `AntiAliasingMethod` | Anti Aliasing Method | `Enum` | `FXAA` | One of: `FXAA`, `TAA`, `Morphological`. | FXAA: fast approximate anti-aliasing of each frame; TAA: temporal anti-aliasing, each frame sampled at another sub-pixel offset and blended with the earlier ones along their motion: smoother, steadier edges and thin details, and point and spot lights' soft shadow edges without their grain (the sun's are the same with any method). TAA Preset chooses how the TAA looks. Morphological: non-temporal, finds edges and blends along them, keeping texture detail. Inactive (it has no effect) when: Anti Aliasing is off. | `TAAPreset` | TAA Preset | `Enum` | `Sharp` | One of: `Sharp`, `Original`, `Custom`. | How the TAA looks. Original: the first TAA, softer and steadier. Custom: the tunables below (choosing it in the Inspector starts from the look in effect). Inactive (it has no effect) when: Anti Aliasing is off; Only TAA uses it (Anti Aliasing Method is {}). Inspector section: Anti-aliasing. |
| `TAAHistoryFrames` | TAA History Frames | `UInt` | `8` | `2.0` to `32.0`. | About how many frames the image averages: the current frame weighs at least 1 / this. Inactive (it has no effect) when: The {} preset sets it ({}): choose Custom to tune it; Anti Aliasing is off; Only TAA uses it (Anti Aliasing Method is {}). Inspector section: Anti-aliasing. |
| `TAAMotionResponse` | TAA Motion Response | `Float` | `0.0625` | `0.0` to `0.25`. | How quickly moving surfaces let go of the history. At 0.0625, motion of 8 pixels a frame weighs the current frame 0.5. Higher keeps moving things crisper and their trails shorter, but they get less anti-aliasing while they move. 0: motion does not matter. Inactive (it has no effect) when: The {} preset sets it ({}): choose Custom to tune it; Anti Aliasing is off; Only TAA uses it (Anti Aliasing Method is {}). Inspector section: Anti-aliasing. |
| `TAAMaxMotionWeight` | TAA Max Motion Weight | `Float` | `0.5` | `0.0` to `1.0`. | The most the current frame weighs, however fast things move. 1 lets very fast motion drop the history: sharp, but aliased. Inactive (it has no effect) when: The {} preset sets it ({}): choose Custom to tune it; Anti Aliasing is off; Only TAA uses it (Anti Aliasing Method is {}). Inspector section: Anti-aliasing. |
| `TAAResampleWeight` | TAA Resample Weight | `Float` | `0.25` | `0.0` to `1.0`. | The current frame's least weight where the history is read between pixels, as in slow pans; it is largest halfway between them. Inactive (it has no effect) when: The {} preset sets it ({}): choose Custom to tune it; Anti Aliasing is off; Only TAA uses it (Anti Aliasing Method is {}). Inspector section: Anti-aliasing. |
| `TAAHistoryClamp` | TAA History Clamp | `Enum` | `Variance` | One of: `MinMax`, `Variance`. | How the history is kept consistent with what the pixel shows now. Tight limits it to a narrower box around their average, which removes more ghosting and trails, most where the surroundings are smooth and less beside glints. Inactive (it has no effect) when: The {} preset sets it ({}): choose Custom to tune it; Anti Aliasing is off; Only TAA uses it (Anti Aliasing Method is {}). Inspector section: Anti-aliasing. |
| `TAAClipWidth` | TAA Clip Width | `Float` | `1.25` | `0.5` to `4.0`. | Tight only: the box's half width, in standard deviations of the colors around the pixel. Inactive (it has no effect) when: The Original preset clamps to the colors' range: choose Custom to tune it; Only Tight clipping uses it (TAA History Clamp is Range); The {} preset sets it ({}): choose Custom to tune it; Anti Aliasing is off; Only TAA uses it (Anti Aliasing Method is {}). | `TAATransparentWeight` | TAA Transparent Weight | `Float` | `0.5` | `0.0` to `1.0`. | The current frame's least weight where a blended transparent surface covers the pixel (half cover or more counts as full). Inactive (it has no effect) when: The {} preset sets it ({}): choose Custom to tune it; Anti Aliasing is off; Only TAA uses it (Anti Aliasing Method is {}). Inspector section: Anti-aliasing. |
| `TAADisocclusionRejection` | TAA Disocclusion Rejection | `Bool` | `true` |   | Drop the history where a surface was just uncovered (something nearer covered it in the previous frame), so moving objects leave no ghost on what they uncover. Inactive (it has no effect) when: The Original preset does not reject uncovered surfaces: choose Custom to tune it; TAA Disocclusion Rejection is off; The {} preset sets it ({}): choose Custom to tune it; Anti Aliasing is off; Only TAA uses it (Anti Aliasing Method is {}). ### ReflectionProbe

Reflections and ambient light inside a box from a capture of the scene around the entity (lighting.bakeProbes renders it); where boxes overlap the two strongest blend

Display name: Reflection Probe · Added by people and tools: yes · Removable: yes

| Property | Display name | Type | Default | Range | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Capture` | Capture | `Asset` | `0000000000000000` | Asset type: `Texture`. | Equirectangular HDR texture of the scene seen from the probe (luminance in nits): Bake writes one. |
| `Extents` | Extents | `Vec3` | `[5, 5, 5]` | `0.009999999776482582` to `1000000.0`. | Half size of the influence box in meters, along the entity's axes (times its scale). |
| `BlendDistance` | Blend Distance | `Float` | `1` | `0.0` to `1000000.0`. | Meters inside the box's faces over which the probe fades into the sky's lighting (or a weaker probe's). |
| `BoxProjection` | Box Projection | `Bool` | `true` |   | Reflections are projected onto the box's faces, so walls near the box's faces reflect where they are (rooms); off, the capture is seen as if infinitely far (open spaces). |
| `Intensity` | Intensity | `Float` | `1` | `0.0` to `1000000.0`. | Multiplies the capture's luminance. |
| `Priority` | Priority | `Int` | `0` | `-1000.0` to `1000.0`. | Where boxes overlap the higher priority wins (then the smaller box); with more probes in view than the renderer keeps, the strongest stay. |

| `ReferenceResolution` | Reference Resolution | `Vec2` | `[1920, 1080]` | `1.0` to `16384.0`. | Scale With Screen: the screen size in pixels the layout is designed for. Inactive (it has no effect) when: Only Scale With Screen and canvases in the world use it (Scale Mode is {}). |
| `MatchWidthOrHeight` | Match Width Or Height | `Float` | `0.5` | `0.0` to `1.0`. | Scale With Screen: 0 follows the screen's width, 1 its height, between them both. Inactive (it has no effect) when: Only Scale With Screen uses it (Scale Mode is {}); A canvas in the world is laid out at its Reference Resolution, not for the screen. |
| `ScaleFactor` | Scale Factor | `Float` | `1` | `0.009999999776482582` to `100.0`. | Multiplies the scale of the constant modes. Inactive (it has no effect) when: Only the constant scale modes use it (Scale Mode is Scale With Screen); A canvas in the world is laid out at its Reference Resolution, not for the screen. |
| `SafeAreaPadding` | Safe Area Padding | `Vec4` | `[0, 0, 0, 0]` | `0.0` to `1000000.0`. | Left, top, right and bottom insets of the canvas's rect, in canvas units. |
| `SortOrder` | Sort Order | `Int` | `0` |   | Canvases with a higher order draw over the others and get input first. |
| `PixelSnap` | Pixel Snap | `Bool` | `true` |   | Rect edges and text baselines on whole pixels. Inactive (it has no effect) when: A canvas in the world has no screen pixels to snap to. |
| `ReceivesInput` | Receives Input | `Bool` | `true` |   | Off: drawn, but never hit by the pointer or reached by navigation (a HUD that never blocks clicks). |
| `FirstSelected` | First Selected | `Entity` | `0000000000000000` |   | The selectable focused when keyboard or gamepad navigation starts. |
| `RenderMode` | Render Mode | `Enum` | `ScreenSpace` | One of: `ScreenSpace`, `WorldSpace`. | Screen Space: over the scene, laid out for the screen; World Space: a plane in the scene at the entity's transform, Reference Resolution canvas units wide and high, depth-tested like world text. |
| `WorldUnitsPerUnit` | World Units Per Unit | `Float` | `0.01` | `9.999999747378752e-06` to `100.0`. | World Space: world units per canvas unit (0.01: a canvas 100 units wide is a meter). Inactive (it has no effect) when: Only a canvas in the world uses it (Render Mode is Screen Space). |

## World

### StreamingSource

A point the world's cells stream around; without an active one, the primary camera is

Display name: Streaming Source · Added by people and tools: yes · Removable: yes

| Property | Display name | Type | Default | Range | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Enabled` | Enabled | `Bool` | `true` |   | Whether the source streams. |
| `Radius` | Radius | `Float` | `0` | `0.0` to `1000000.0`. | Streams the cells within this distance on every layer; 0: each layer's streaming distance. |
| `Layers` | Layers | `String` | `""` |   | The layers it streams, separated by commas; empty: every enabled layer. |
| `Priority` | Priority | `Int` | `0` | `-100.0` to `100.0`. | Higher-priority sources' cells load first. |
| `ViewBias` | View Bias | `Float` | `0.25` | `0.0` to `1.0`. | Cells ahead of the source (its -Z axis) load as if this share of the radius nearer. |

## Components the list leaves out

`component.list` leaves out hidden components and those the scene stores itself (NoSerialize). They are registered in the source:

| Component | Flags | Properties | Description | Registered at |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ID` | `Hidden`, `NotRemovable`, `NoSerialize` | `ID` |   | `Strata/src/Strata/Scene/ComponentRegistration.cpp:70` |
| `Inactive` | `Hidden` |   | Deactivates the entity and its descendants | `Strata/src/Strata/Scene/ComponentRegistration.cpp:98` |
| `Relationship` | `Hidden`, `NotRemovable`, `NoSerialize` | `Parent` |   | `Strata/src/Strata/Scene/ComponentRegistration.cpp:88` |

## Properties the list leaves out

Hidden properties are stored but not shown; transient ones are not stored.

| Component | Property | Flags | Registered at |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `PrefabInstance` | `PrefabVersion` | `ReadOnly`, `Hidden` | `Strata/src/Strata/Scene/ComponentRegistration.cpp:119` |
| `PrefabInstance` | `SyncedHash` | `ReadOnly`, `Hidden` | `Strata/src/Strata/Scene/ComponentRegistration.cpp:123` |
